Why Customers Choose Us

What Makes Liquor & Wine Outlet the Best?

Four things set Liquor & Wine Outlet apart from other Murfreesboro liquor stores: the depth of our curation, the experience of our staff, our access to rare and allocated bottles, and a community-first ownership model.

500+ Curated Bottles

Liquor & Wine Outlet's shelves carry over 500 premium wines and spirits — chosen, not just stocked. From everyday favorites to vintage Champagne and aged scotch.

100+ Rare & Allocated

One of the deepest selections of hard-to-find allocated bourbons, limited-edition spirits, and vintage wines in Rutherford County. Special orders welcomed.

Expert Staff on Duty

Knowledgeable team that pairs wines with meals, recommends bourbons by flavor profile, and finds cigars for the occasion — not generic chain-store upselling.

Locally Owned

A locally owned business invested in the Murfreesboro community for 15+ years — not a corporate chain. We see our customers as neighbors, not transactions.

The Difference

How Liquor & Wine Outlet Compares

Independent neighborhood store vs. chain liquor store

Chain liquor stores in Murfreesboro stock what corporate buying decides — the same SKUs every week, generic placement, and staff who often cannot answer specific questions about bourbon mash bills or wine vintages. The "best liquor store" experience requires more than shelf space.

Liquor & Wine Outlet curates: each bottle on the shelf is intentional. Our buyer hunts allocated bourbons that chains do not get, partners with local Tennessee breweries chain managers cannot order, and trains staff to actually taste and recommend. When you walk into 2003 SE Broad Street, you walk into a store that knows what it carries.

This is why long-time Murfreesboro customers, collectors, and gift-buyers come back. Visit in person or call (615) 624-6928 with a request and see the difference.
